modmenu.summaryTranslation.offlineskins-: Caches player skins for offline use.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.offlinesk:
OfflineSkins Reloaded for Fabric 26.2. Caches player skins for offline use.
Ported by VoreZ.
tooltip.DisablePlayerHeads: Hides player heads in the tab list.
tooltip.use.Mojang: Uses the official Minecraft skin and cape provider.
tooltip.use.Crafatar: Use when Mojang servers don't respond and aren't giving skins or capes.
options.CustomServer: Use Custom Skin and Cape URLs
tooltip.use.CustomServer: Enable custom skin and cape URLs. These URLs apply to both skins and capes. Ely.by is recommended.
tooltip.allowHTTP: Allows custom skin and cape URLs to use HTTP. HTTPS is still preferred, but HTTP can be useful for trusted providers that do not offer HTTPS yet. If you use an unknown server, consider leaving this off.
option.use.server.from.list: Choose a preset server from the list
tooltip.use.server.from.list: Lets you quickly configure Ely.by without manually entering URLs. Player rendering may have bugs when switching between servers very quickly. If that happens, try disabling Custom Server and then enabling it again.
tooltip.offlineskins-reloaded.link_custo:
Custom skin URL.
Example: https://exampleserver.com/skins/%auto%
Use %auto% as a placeholder for the player's nickname.

Custom cape URL.
Example: https://exampleserver.com/capes/%auto%
Use %auto% as a placeholder for the player's nickname.
error.fail: The link must contain the %auto% placeholder
error.404: 404 error: page or file not found
error.invalid.skin: Error: skin is not vanilla resolution (HD skins are not allowed)
error.invalid.cape: Error: cape is not vanilla resolution
tooltip.allow.HD: Optimizes network traffic by replacing players with HD skins or capes with the standard red Steve placeholder marked with an exclamation point on the cape and skin. Local HD skins are always available on the client. Recommended to leave it disabled by default.
tooltip.offlineskins.check_skin: Check the skin URL. Required to save and check
tooltip.offlineskins.check_cape: Check the cape URL. Required to save and check
error.custom-server-disabled: Enable Custom Server to use custom skin and cape URLs.
use.of.http.is.denied: HTTP connections are not allowed because of security terms. Please use HTTPS.
tooltip.offlineskins.reload: Reload the OfflineSkins Reloaded connection to the custom servers.
toast.offlineskins.reload.success: Reconnected to the custom server for OfflineSkins Reloaded
